fusions.name: Threshing Floor
fusions.desc: Beats a full circle that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Common Cause
fusions.desc: A flattening blow that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, your allies strike 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil-Sharp
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Armour Laid Flat
fusions.desc: Your slashing damage cannot be resisted.
